app_architecture.structure: Hybrid Fullstack - 3 integrated modules with unified mock state and Leaflet map support

modules.name: Portal / Landing Switcher
modules.description: Unified entry point with live preview toggles between Customer Mobile App, Partner Mobile App, and Admin Desktop Console
modules.viewport: Responsive desktop wrapper with device frame simulators

modules.name: Customer App
modules.viewport: Centered mobile-style web viewport (390px-430px container on desktop)
key_features: Live Tracking with 4-Step Stepper & Half-Screen Map

modules.name: Partner App
modules.viewport: Centered mobile-style web viewport with high contrast outdoor theme
modules.theme: High-contrast outdoor visibility (#FFFFFF background, #F4F5F7 cards, high readability #0F172A typography)
key_features: KYC Verification Upload (Aadhaar, PAN, DL, Police)
15-second Incoming Job Modal with Earnings & Countdown
4-Step Active Job Stepper (Arrived -> OTP -> Parts -> Complete)

modules.name: Admin Panel
modules.theme: Dark Sidebar (#0F172A) with Light Slate Content Canvas (#F8FAFC)
key_features: 240px Fixed Sidebar & Top Header with Global Search
4 Real-time KPI Cards (Bookings, Active Jobs, Revenue, Partners)
Recharts Revenue & Booking Trends + Category Donut Chart
Geofencing Map Polygon Canvas + Pincode CSV Upload
KYC Approval Queue & Partner Commission Engine (15-20%)

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Every interactive element MUST have explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='customer-book-now-btn').
No full transparent dropdowns or fixed headers. Always use blur backdrop or solid color with 1px border.
Mobile views (Customer & Partner) must render within a sleek frame container on desktop screens to allow testing without actual mobile hardware.
Use Sonner for pop-up toast alerts (booking confirmation, OTP sent, job accepted, SOS triggered).
Include real-time countdown timer (15s) in Partner App for incoming job offer modals.
Support dark fixed sidebar (#0F172A) for Admin and bright outdoor light mode (#FFFFFF/#F4F5F7) for Partner App.
